name: io.github.mnemoverse/mcp-memory-server
title: Mnemoverse Memory
description: Hosted agent memory that learns from outcomes, with shared rooms. No key: mcp.mnemoverse.com/mcp

environmentVariables.name: MNEMOVERSE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Mnemoverse API key (starts with mk_live_), for this local package. The hosted server https://mcp.mnemoverse.com/mcp needs no key: it signs in with OAuth, and it also accepts this key as a bearer token. Optional to install and inspect: this local package starts and lists its tools without a key, and every tool call it makes requires one. Get one free in ~30s at https://console.mnemoverse.com

environmentVariables.name: MNEMOVERSE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Mnemoverse API base URL. Leave as the default; override only for testing against a non-production environment.
